change.title: AKS platform and node pool upgrade — not an executed change
change.purpose: Assess a planned AKS platform and node pool upgrade owned by the Infra team.
change.scope: Customer-controlled upgrade scheduling, node pools, access/network policy and platform diagnostics; application image changes are excluded.
change.expectedOutcome: The platform and dependent workloads remain healthy after an independently reviewed, supported change.
change.riskAssessment: Synthetic risk: node disruption, workload compatibility and insufficient spare capacity could affect availability.
change.securityImpact: Not assessed. Compare customer-managed access and network controls before and after the proposed change.
change.fallbackPlan: Proposed: document a supported recovery and escalation path before approval; do not assume a Kubernetes version downgrade is available. No recovery has been tested.

evidence.summary: Illustrative platform change description only; no live inventory, compatibility test, independent approval or execution evidence exists.
